description: Aardbevingsgebied (Omgevingsverordening) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.provinciegroningen.nl. This file contains the boundaries of the earthquake area as laid down in the Environmental Ordinance of the Province of Groningen. The Regulation lays down rules to prevent total or partial demolition of characteristic buildings in the earthquake area without prior careful weighting. That is why it has been designated for which area it is. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Earthquake Area (Environmental Regulation)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
